title: Commitment-Based Teacher-Student Fidelity Auditing with Public Randomness and Finite-Population Certification — Reproduction Package
description: Reproduction package for a prespecified fixed-population fidelity audit on 2,048 constructed and human-reviewed maintenance reports. The primary sample contained 64 disagreements in 768 items, yielding an exact hypergeometric upper total of 200/2048 (9.765625%); the later census found 158/2048. The guarantee assumes a fixed disagreement table and uniform sampling without replacement. Includes raw evidence, selected LoRA adapter (base weights excluded), offline verification, editable manuscript sources and PDF. Code is MIT; author-controlled manuscript/data is CC BY 4.0; model and third-party notices remain applicable. This is an empirical integration case study, not peer-reviewed publication or proof of API stationarity.
